text: Hi all! I’m Alex, from Italy. Nice to meet you all! I’ll be finishing my PhD at the Technion in January. My partner is from here and I would like to kickstart my career in Israel. I’m applying for jobs but it’s hard, at the same time we are preparing the documents to start the couple visa process. So far as we understand it’s better to start the process while here under another visa type. My student visa expires in June. The big question at the moment is are we still on time?
